action.description: none: nothing to do. comment: post body. close: close the issue or pull request, after posting body when not empty. merge: squash-merge the pull request, after posting body when not empty.

reason.description: Why this action, for the maintainer only, never posted.

body.description: The comment the maintainer would post under their name. May be empty for close and merge, empty for none.

verdict.description: Pull requests only, for the maintainer only, never posted. merge: ready as is. changes: concrete changes needed first. discuss: a direction call for the maintainer. n/a: not a pull request.

review.description: Pull requests only, for the maintainer only, never posted: the case for the verdict. Empty for n/a.
